messages.en:
{07 04 00}My gift was a dud?{01 00 00 0f 00} I can't
even begin to understand
that, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}{07 05 00}I guess that's what I get 
for giving something decent
to a tasteless yokel.
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Mu kingitus oli mööda?{01 00 00 0f 00} Ma ei
suuda seda üldse mõista,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}{07 05 00}Vist saangi seda, kui annan
midagi korralikku
maitsetule külamatsile.

messages.en:
{07 04 00}What?! {01 00 00 05 00}The gift went over 
like a lump of lunch meat?

{07 15 00}Is it even possible to be
more ungrateful?! {01 00 00 05 00}That
animal has no taste.
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Mida?! {01 00 00 05 00}Kingitus läks peale
nagu külm lihatükk?

{07 15 00}Kas saab olla veel
tänamatum?! {01 00 00 05 00}Sellel loomal
pole maitset.
